en.headline: Shui Pin Wai Estate hit by second power cut within 18 hours
en.dek: Temporary cables installed after the morning outage failed around 10.30pm on Tuesday, leaving about 2,200 households without electricity for roughly 30 minutes and trapping residents in lifts.
body: CLP Power said temporary cables laid after the morning underground-cable fault at Shui Pin Wai Estate in Yuen Long became unstable at about 10.31pm on Tuesday, cutting supply to roughly 2,200 customers in the estate.

Fire services received multiple reports of people trapped in lifts. Supply was restored within about half an hour after engineers carried out remote switching and on-site repairs. Only Hong Shui House remained unaffected during both outages.

CLP said the original morning fault, which left about 2,400 households without power from around 4.22am until 10.45am, is under investigation and may involve third-party interference. Residents endured indoor temperatures above 30 degrees during the second blackout.

zh.headline: 水邊圍邨18小時內兩度停電 臨時電纜不穩再斷約半小時
zh.dek: 中電指早上搶修後鋪設的臨時電纜於周二晚約10時31分供電不穩，影響約2,200戶約半小時，消防接獲多宗困𨋢報告。
body: 中電表示，元朗水邊圍邨周二凌晨因地底電纜故障停電後，工程人員鋪設臨時電纜恢復供電。同日晚上約10時31分，臨時電纜線路懷疑因供電不穩，一度影響邨內約2,200名客戶的電力供應。
消防接獲多宗困𨋢報告。經即時搶修及遙距復電後，約半小時內為所有受影響客戶恢復供電。兩次停電中，僅康水樓未受影響。
中電指早上故障初步調查懷疑與第三方干擾有關，會繼續跟進。第二次停電期間，元朗氣溫仍超過30度，有居民摸黑步行落樓避暑。
